No persistent derived cache, invalidation scheme, ledger/receipt mutation or new retention ownership. Shared global deadline and complete-results-before-success remain; unsafe/malformed/error/late evidence refuses the whole snapshot with no partial ACKs. Benchmark first; if contention prevents reliable bounded completion, report actual fixture/latency evidence and an explicit derived-evidence/invalidation alternative rather than weakening bounds.
